findings.fix: Capture console/result/offset/optimistic row key; block transitions until editing/staging resolved; keyboard navigation

findings.problem: Routine document could fall through generic execute while definition loading; restart adopted changed server baseline
findings.fix: Host routine-only apply, persistent committed/session baseline, terminal receipt, explicit CAS DDL reload preserving prior text

findings.problem: Debounced SQL and unmounted failed drafts could be lost on tab/window close
findings.fix: Shared retained draft queue, awaited tab/window flush, dynamic read-only, window freeze, repeat-quit protection

findings.problem: Retargeted old documents looked like new-server data

findings.problem: Async waitForFunction predicate Promise was treated as immediate success by installed Playwright
findings.fix: Await actual evaluated value in Node poll; explicit negative control for async false
findings.verification: 43 live PostgreSQL cases and 25 production Electron cases passed on current macOS source; corrected grid acceptance repeated under PostgreSQL load. Windows pending.

findings.problem: Equal sibling keys for SQL/metadata caused retained editors during production React refresh
findings.fix: Unique key namespaces and explicit single editor ownership; one-editor invariant across metadata refresh
findings.verification: 43 live PostgreSQL cases and 25 production Electron cases passed on current macOS source; corrected grid acceptance repeated under PostgreSQL load. Windows pending.

findings.problem: Native Quit silently rolled back an active manual transaction; forgiving status errors could be mistaken for safety
findings.fix: Strict parallel fresh status with a 5-second SDK timeout/cancellation. Status failure cannot erase a previously known open transaction. Active, failed, busy, opening or unavailable leases block shutdown; reject new windows during the barrier
findings.verification: 43 live PostgreSQL cases and 25 production Electron cases passed on current macOS source; corrected grid acceptance repeated under PostgreSQL load. Windows pending.

findings.problem: Untitled and failed recovery flush were not protected at native shutdown; separate native editor remained editable during recovery
findings.fix: Native IDE preflight suspends the separate view, drains accepted bridge mutations and checks actual dirty documents before disposal. File-backed recovery is confirmed by POST plus exact GET readback; unsupported dirty documents require Save As. Failed persistence cancels shutdown and restores the view
findings.verification: 45 live Electron/Theia regression cases passed on current macOS source; exact guards additionally reviewed. Windows pending.

findings.problem: An already accepted stop/restart could finish its async preparation after global shutdown changed ownership; late preparation must not freeze or destroy a restored editor
findings.fix: Check close epoch and suspended ownership after readiness and after executeJavaScript. Main rejects new IDE mutations during shutdown; local stop/restart rejects concurrent suspended ownership and rechecks global shutdown before destroying a view
findings.verification: 45 live Electron/Theia regression cases passed on current macOS source; exact guards additionally reviewed. Windows pending.

findings.problem: A timed-out offline recovery write could publish its old snapshot after a newer retry because timeout alone does not cancel filesystem I/O
findings.fix: Per-file serialized recovery publisher with timeout cancellation token; stale attempt checks before publish; queue prevents an already-issued old OS rename from overtaking newer publication
findings.verification: Two actual temporary-filesystem delayed-sync/cancellation/superseding tests and 45 live IDE regression cases passed; Windows pending.

findings.problem: A later parallel acceptance rerun exposed a readiness gap: the selected result could differ from the page currently available for grid editing
findings.fix: canEdit now requires page.id === resultId and page.offset === offset. DOM result identity/editability and aria-busy expose actual readiness; the UI test waits for the latest completed job's result ID before F2
findings.verification: 43 live PostgreSQL cases and 25 production Electron cases passed on current macOS source; corrected grid acceptance repeated under PostgreSQL load. Windows pending.
